profile.name: Bharath
profile.tagline: I build secure, delightful digital experiences — turning ideas into fast, beautiful, resilient software.

about:
Hi! I'm a passionate technologist who loves solving hard problems at the intersection of security and great user experience.

Over the years I've shipped projects, competed in hackathons, and earned certifications across web development, cloud, and cybersecurity. I care deeply about clean code, thoughtful design, and always learning something new.

When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new tech, contributing to open source, or mentoring others.
